definitions.explanation: The act of dividing something into separate parts or sections. Used for physical objects, payments, data, and abstract concepts.

examples.japanese: {分割|ぶんかつ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分割|ぶんかつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The land was divided into three parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分割|ぶんかつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}できる→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧。
examples.english: You can split the screen and display two apps at the same time.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (to divide) + {割|かつ} (to split). A common word in finance, technology, and everyday contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分割|ぶんかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to divide, to split)
- {分割|ぶんかつ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ (installment payment)
- {分割|ぶんかつ}⟦{統治|とうち}→統治：13842_touchi⟧ (divide and rule)
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧{分割|ぶんかつ} (split screen)
- {株式|かぶしき}{分割|ぶんかつ} (stock split)
- {分割|ぶんかつ}⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧ (split file)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分割|ぶんかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to divide ~ into two)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {分割|ぶんかつ}: dividing one thing into defined parts (often deliberate, planned)
- ⟦{分離|ぶんり}→分離：11773_bunri⟧: separating things that were connected
- ⟦{分裂|ぶんれつ}→分裂：11747_bunretsu⟧: splitting apart, often with a sense of conflict or fragmentation
